title: VoxForge: A Unified Foundation Model for Dense 3D Features Across MRI, CT and PET
abstract: arXiv:2611.25309v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A unified 3D medical foundation model promises reusable, frozen features that serve a wide variety of tasks such as segmentation, classification and registration on MRI, CT and PET as well as specialist models do. Generalist models still need separate backbones for localized and global tasks, specialist models are confined to a single modality, with the concern that spanning modalities under-emphasizes fine anatomy, and both typically rely on end-to-end fine-tuning to be competitive. We present VoxForge, a single encoder that integrates recent advances in 3D architecture, self-distillation and cross-modal curricula to learn transferable features from permissively licensed MRI and CT volumes. We evaluate it strictly frozen, the test a reusable foundation model must pass, against state-of-the-art generalist and specialist models on segmentation, classification and registration across MRI and CT, and on PET, which it never sees. VoxForge

translated_title: VoxForge：跨MRI、CT和PET的密集3D特征统一基础模型
translated_abstract: 统一的3D医学基础模型有望提供可复用的冻结特征，能够像专用模型一样出色地完成分割、分类和配准等多种任务，覆盖MRI、CT和PET。目前的通用模型仍需要为局部任务和全局任务分别配置骨干网络；专用模型则局限于单一模态，且人们担心跨模态训练会弱化精细解剖结构；此外，这两类模型通常都依赖端到端微调才能保持竞争力。我们提出了VoxForge——一个单一编码器，它整合了3D架构、自蒸馏和跨模态课程学习的最新进展，从采用宽松许可协议的MRI和CT体数据中学习可迁移的特征。我们严格在冻结状态下对其进行评估——这是可复用基础模型必须通过的测试——将其与最先进的通用模型和专用模型在MRI和CT上的分割、分类和配准任务中进行比较，并在其从未见过的PET数据上加以测试。VoxForge
tldr: 提出VoxForge，一个融合3D架构、自蒸馏与跨模态课程学习的统一医学基础模型编码器，在完全冻结状态下即可在MRI和CT的分割、分类、配准任务上媲美通用与专用模型，并能泛化到训练中从未见过的PET模态。
en_tdlr: VoxForge is a unified 3D medical foundation model encoder combining advances in 3D architecture, self-distillation, and cross-modal curricula, whose strictly frozen features match generalist and specialist models on MRI/CT segmentation, classification, and registration while generalizing to unseen PET data.
